title: UNIFY: Unified Learning with One Model via Batch Norm Switching
abstract: arXiv:2611.28746v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks are typically trained separately for individual datasets or tasks, resulting in many task-specific models. This redundancy increases memory footprint, deployment costs, and energy consumption limiting their scalability. We propose UNIFY, a unified learning framework that enables a single model to jointly learn and perform inference across multiple datasets via Batch Normalization Switching (BNS). Instead of maintaining separate models for each dataset, UNIFY shares the parameter-intensive backbone while maintaining dataset-specific BN statistics and parameters, along with dataset-specific classification heads. We validate our framework using five datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet) across six Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) of different sizes (SqueezeNet 1.1, WideResNet-40-2, WideResNet-16-8, ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50). translated_title: UNIFY：通过批归一化切换实现单模型统一学习
translated_abstract: 神经网络通常针对单个数据集或任务分别进行训练，从而产生大量特定任务的模型。这种冗余增加了内存占用、部署成本和能耗，限制了系统的可扩展性。我们提出了UNIFY，这是一个统一学习框架，通过批归一化切换（Batch Normalization Switching, BNS）使单个模型能够在多个数据集上联合学习并执行推理。UNIFY不再为每个数据集维护单独的模型，而是共享参数密集的主干网络，同时维护各数据集专用的BN统计量与参数，以及数据集专用的分类头。我们使用五个数据集（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet）和六种不同规模的卷积神经网络（SqueezeNet 1.1、WideResNet-40-2、WideResNet-16-8、ResNet-18、ResNet-34、ResNet-50）对该框架进行了验证。值得注意的是，一个在这些数据集上统一训练的ResNet-34……
tldr: UNIFY提出一种通过批归一化切换的统一学习框架，让单个模型共享主干网络并配合数据集专用的BN参数与分类头，即可在多个数据集上联合训练与推理，从而减少多模型冗余带来的内存、部署成本和能耗。
en_tdlr: UNIFY is a unified learning framework that enables a single model to jointly learn and perform inference across multiple datasets by sharing a common backbone while switching dataset-specific Batch Normalization statistics and classification heads, reducing the redundancy, memory footprint, and deployment costs of maintaining multiple task-specific models.
